title: RadImageNet-VQA: A Large-Scale CT and MRI Dataset for Radiologic Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models in a text-only setting (with images removed) to measure their reliance on textual priors, dataset frequency, and linguistic regularities rather than actual visual grounding.

Varying the frequency of a 'no pathology seen' distractor option in multiple-choice questions to measure the models' tendency to assume a disease is present and ignore normal anatomical baseline options.
